name: Advanced Study Benefit and Drawback
power_roll: Power Roll + Reason or Intuition or Presence or Agility or Might
tier_1: You summon a hostile demon of your level or lower who attacks you at the end of the respite. The demon gets to act first in the combat, no matter any other creature’s traits or abilities.
tier_2: You learn nothing and your time is wasted.
tier_3: You learn one bonus heroic ability from your class that you qualify for. You only know the ability until you finish your next respite.
description: As a respite activity, you can study the notebook.

name: Exploding Arrow
power_roll: Power Roll + Agility or Reason or Intuition or Presence
tier_1: 3 + A, R, I, or P fire damage
tier_2: 5 + A, R, I, or P fire damage
tier_3: 8 + A, R, I, or P fire damage
effect: One creature or object of your choice within 2 squares of the target takes fire damage equal to the characteristic score used for this ability's power roll.
description: Your ammunition explodes with magical energy.

name: Showstopper
effect: If you kill a non-minion opponent using this ability, each enemy within 3 squares of you is frightened (save ends).
description: Show's over, kids!

name: Telepathy
target: One creature who understands a language you know
effect: You communicate telepathically with the target. The targer can respond telepathically as part of the same maneuver.

name: Charge!
target: Self and each ally in the area
effect: Each target can use the Charge main action.
description: Follow me!

name: Unmooring
power_roll: Power Roll + Might or Reason or Intuition or Presence
tier_1: 3 + M, R, I, or P damage
tier_2: 6 + M, R, I, or P damage
tier_3: 9 + M, R, I, or P damage
effect: Until the end of the target's next turn, any forced movement that affects the target has its distance increased by 2.
description: Your weapon unleashes psionic energy that reduces your target’s weight.

name: Bear Claws
description: Attacks with your sharp and deadly claws grab the weak.

name: Duck!
type: Triggered Action (An enemy strikes you while a second creature is flanking you)
effect: You redirect the strike against the second creature. Once you use this benefit, you can’t use it again until you earn 1 or more Victories.

name: Arrest
effect: If the target makes a strike against a creature while grabbed this way, you can spend 3 wrath to deal holy damage to them equal to your Presence score, then change the target of the strike to another target within the strike’s distance.
description: “I got you, you son of a bitch.”

name: Back, Blasphemer!
description: You channel power through your weapon to repel foes.

name: Behold the Face of Justice!
tier_1: 3 + M holy damage; if the target has P < [weak], each enemy within 2 squares of them is frightened of you (save ends)
tier_2: 5 + M holy damage; if the target has P < [average], each enemy within 2 squares of them is frightened of you (save ends)
tier_3: 8 + M holy damage; if the target has P < [strong], each enemy within 2 squares of them is frightened of you (save ends)
effect: Each enemy frightened by this ability is pushed 2 squares away from the target and takes psychic damage equal to your Presence score.
description: You attack a foe and your enemies behold a vision of the true nature of your resolve.

name: Behold, a Shield of Faith!
effect: Until the start of your next turn, enemies have a bane on ability rolls made against you and each ally adjacent to you.
description: A mighty blow turns your foe’s vitality into a holy light that envelops you and an ally, discouraging enemies who might attack you.

name: Censored
effect: When a target who is not a leader or solo creature is made winded by this ability, they are reduced to 0 Stamina.
description: Judged and sentenced.

name: Driving Assault
effect: You can shift up to your speed in a straight line toward the target after pushing them.
description: As you force your enemy back with your weapon, you use your faith to stay close.

name: Edict of Disruptive Isolation
effect: Until the end of the encounter or until you are dying, each target takes holy damage equal to your Presence score at the end of each of your turns. A target takes an extra 2d6 holy damage if they are judged by you or if they are adjacent to any enemy.
description: The evil within your foes detonates with holy fire that burns only the guilty.

name: Edict of Perfect Order
effect: Until the end of the encounter or until you are dying, whenever a target uses an ability that costs Malice, they take holy damage equal to three times your Presence score. A target judged by you takes an extra 2d6 holy damage.
description: Within the area of your divine presence, your enemies will regret using their fell abilities.

name: Edict of Purifying Pacifism
effect: Until the end of the encounter or until you are dying, whenever a target makes a strike, they take holy damage equal to twice your Presence score. A target judged by you takes an extra 2d6 holy damage.
description: You shed a righteous energy that punishes enemies who would harm you or your allies.

name: Edict of Stillness
effect: Until the end of the encounter or until you are dying, whenever a target moves or is force moved out of the area, they take holy damage equal to twice your Presence score. A target judged by you who moves willingly takes an extra 2d6 holy damage.
description: The holy aura you project makes it painful for evil-doers to leave your reach.

name: Every Step ... Death!
effect: Each time the target willingly moves before the end of your next turn, they take 1 psychic damage for each square they move.
description: You show your foe a glimpse of their fate after death.

name: Excommunication
effect: At the end of each of your turns, a target weakened this way deals holy damage equal to twice your Presence score to each enemy within 2 squares of them. Additionally, a target weakened this way can’t be targeted by their allies’ abilities.
description: You curse your foe to become a bane to their allies.

name: Gods Grant Thee Strength
effect: The target ends any condition or effect on them that is ended by a saving throw or that ends at the end of their turn, or a prone target can stand up. The target then gains 2 surges, can shift up to their speed while ignoring difficult terrain, and can use a strike signature ability as a free triggered action.
description: You channel divine force for movement that cannot be stopped.

name: Halt, Miscreant!
tier_1: 2 + M holy damage; P < [weak], slowed (save ends)
tier_2: 5 + M holy damage; P < [average], slowed (save ends)
tier_3: 7 + M holy damage; P < [strong], slowed (save ends)
description: You infuse your weapon with holy magic that makes it difficult for your foe to get away.

name: Hand of the Gods
effect: Until the end of the encounter, while the target is judged by you, you can choose to make them the source of any of your abilities. Additionally, the target counts as an ally for the purpose of flanking.
description: You use your foe as a tool against your enemies.

name: Judgment
effect:
The target is judged by you until the end of the encounter, you use this ability again, you willingly end this effect (no action required), or another censor judges the target.

Whenever a creature judged by you uses a main action and is within your line of effect, you can use a free triggered action to deal holy damage equal to twice your Presence score to them.

When a creature judged by you is reduced to 0 Stamina, you can use a free triggered action to use this ability against a new target.

Additionally, you can spend 1 wrath to take one of the following free triggered actions:

* When an adjacent creature judged by you starts to shift, you make a melee free strike against them and their speed becomes 0 until the end of the current turn, preventing them from shifting.
* When a creature judged by you within 10 squares makes a power roll, you cause them to take a bane on the roll.
* When a creature judged by you within 10 squares uses an ability with a potency that targets only one creature, the potency is reduced by 1 for that creature.
* If you damage a creature judged by you with a melee ability, the creature is taunted by you until the end of their next turn.

You can choose only one free triggered action option at a time, even if multiple options are triggered by the same effect.
description: You utter a prayer that outlines your foe in holy energy.

name: My Life for Yours
type: Triggered Action (The target starts their turn or takes damage.)
effect:
You spend a Recovery and the target regains Stamina equal to your Recovery value.

Spend 1: You can end one effect on the target that is ended by a saving throw or that ends at the end of their turn, or a prone target can stand up.
description: You channel some of your vitality into more resilience for you or an ally.

name: Orison of Victory
target: Self and each ally in the area
effect: A target can end one effect on them that is ended by a saving throw or that ends at the end of their turn, or a prone target can stand up.
description: You channel your god’s will to overcome hardship and inflict pain.

name: Pillar of Holy Fire
effect: At the end of each of your turns, a target dazed this way deals holy damage equal to twice your Presence score to each enemy within 2 squares of them.
description: Your enemy’s guilt fuels a holy flame that burns your foes.

name: Purifying Fire
tier_1: 5 + M holy damage; M < [weak], the target has fire weakness 3 (save ends)
tier_2: 9 + M holy damage; M < [average], the target has fire weakness 5 (save ends)
tier_3: 12 + M holy damage; M < [strong], the target has fire weakness 7 (save ends)
effect: While the target has fire weakness from this ability, you can choose to have your abilities deal fire damage to the target instead of holy damage.
description: The gods judge, fire cleanses.

name: Repent!
tier_1: 5 + P holy damage; I < [weak], dazed (save ends)
tier_2: 8 + P holy damage; I < [average], dazed (save ends)
tier_3: 11 + P holy damage; I < [strong], dazed (save ends)
description: You conjure memories of their sins to harry your foes.

name: Righteous Judgment
effect: Until the end of the encounter, whenever any ally deals damage to a target judged by you, that ally gains 1 surge.
description: You amplify the power of your judgment.

name: Shield of the Righteous
tier_1: 10 + M damage; you and each ally adjacent to you gain 10 temporary Stamina
tier_2: 14 + M damage; you and each ally adjacent to you gain 15 temporary Stamina
tier_3: 20 + M damage; you and each ally adjacent to you gain 20 temporary Stamina
description: You strike a foe and create a fleet of divine shields that protect your allies.

name: The Gods Punish and Defend
effect: You can spend a Recovery to allow yourself or one ally within 10 squares to regain Stamina equal to your recovery value.
description: You channel holy energy to smite a foe and heal an ally.

name: Your Allies Cannot Save You!
effect: Each enemy adjacent to the target is pushed away from the target up to a number of squares equal to your Presence score.
description: Your magic strike turns your foe’s guilt into a burst of holy power

name: Your Allies Turn on You!
effect: While the target is slowed this way, each of their allies who starts their turn within 5 squares of them must use a free maneuver to make a free strike against the target. Additionally, while the target is slowed this way, each of their allies within 5 squares of them who can make a triggered free strike against a different creature must make the free strike against the target instead.
description: You turn your enemies’ ire to the target.

name: Banish
tier_1: 5 + M damage; P < [weak], the target is banished (save ends)
tier_2: 8 + M damage; P < [average], the target is banished (save ends)
tier_3: 11 + M damage; P < [strong], the target is banished (save ends)
effect: This ability gains an edge against demons, devils, undead, and creatures not native to your current world. If you know the target’s true name, this ability has a double edge. While banished, the target is sent to another manifold in the timescape and removed from the encounter map. A banished target can do nothing but make saving throws, and takes 10 holy damage each time they do so. If the target is reduced to 0 Stamina while banished, they are lost to the timescape.
description: You sever the target’s tenuous connection to the world.

name: Begone
description: You terrify your enemies into retreating, creating chaos in their ranks.

name: It Is Justice You Fear
tier_1: 8 + M holy damage; P < [weak], frightened (save ends)
tier_2: 12 + M holy damage; P < [average], frightened (save ends)
tier_3: 15 + M holy damage; P < [strong], frightened (save ends)
effect: If the target is already frightened of you or another creature and this ability would frighten them again, they instead take psychic damage equal to twice your Presence score.
description: I am but a vessel. Your own deeds weigh upon you.

name: Pain of Your Own Making
type: Triggered Action (The target gains a condition or effect that is ended by a saving throw or that ends at the end of their turn.)
effect: The effect ends on the target and is applied to the creature who imposed the effect on them. That creature also takes damage equal to three times your Presence score.
description: You reverse the effects from an evildoer.

name: Revelator
effect: Each target takes holy damage equal to twice your Presence score. Additionally, each hidden target is automatically revealed and can’t become hidden again until the start of your next turn. You can then use your Judgment ability against one target as a free triggered action.
description: You channel holy energy to harm unbelievers and reveal those hidden from your judgment.

name: Terror Manifest
tier_1: 7 + P psychic damage; P < [weak], frightened (save ends)
tier_2: 10 + P psychic damage; P < [average], frightened (save ends)
tier_3: 12 + P psychic damage; P < [strong], frightened (save ends)
effect: While frightened this way, if a target who is a leader or solo creature is winded, they take an extra 25 psychic damage. If a target frightened this way is not a leader or solo creature and is winded, they are reduced to 0 Stamina.
description: “I know what you fear.”

name: Blessing and a Curse
type: Triggered Action (The target makes a power roll.)
effect: The target obtains a tier 1 or tier 3 outcome on their power roll (your choice). You can then choose another target within distance, who obtains the opposite outcome on their next power roll.
description: The gods bless and damn in equal measure.

name: Burden of Evil
description: You reveal a vision of your enemies’ fate that causes them to scramble as it staggers them.

name: Edict of Peace
effect: Until the end of the encounter or until you are dying, whenever any target takes a triggered action or a free triggered action, that action is negated and the target takes holy damage equal to your Presence score.
description: You anticipate your foes’ moves and deny them.

name: Fulfill Your Destiny
type: Triggered Action (You or another hero ends their turn.)
effect: The target takes their turn after the triggering hero, and immediately removes all conditions and negative effects on themself. During their turn, the target has a double edge on power rolls.
description: You have looked at various futures, and only this one works.

name: Prescient Grace
type: Triggered Action (An enemy within 10 squares starts their turn.)
effect: You can spend a Recovery to allow the target to regain Stamina equal to your recovery value. The target can then take their turn immediately before the triggering enemy.
description: Gifted by a prescient vision, you warn an ally of an impending attack.

name: With My Blessing
effect: The target can use a free triggered action to use a strike signature ability or a strike heroic ability, and has a double edge on that ability. If a heroic ability is chosen, reduce its Heroic Resource cost by 3 (to a minimum cost of 0).
description: A word in prayer, and the gods show the way.

name: Apostate
effect: Until the end of the encounter or until you are dying, the target has damage weakness 10.
description: You channel holy energy to seal an enemy’s fate.

name: Blessing of the Faithful
target: Self and each ally in the area
effect: Until the end of the encounter or until you are dying, each target in the aura gains 1 surge at the end of each of your turns.
description: The gods reward your faith.

name: Congregation
tier_1: 8 + M damage; as a free triggered action, one ally within 10 squares of the target can use a strike signature ability against the target
tier_2: 12 + M damage; as a free triggered action, one ally within 10 squares of the target can use a strike signature ability that gains an edge against the target
tier_3: 16 + M damage; as a free triggered action, two allies within 10 squares of the target can each use a strike signature ability that gains an edge against the target
effect: Each ally can shift up to 2 squares and gains 2 surges before making the strike.
description: You focus your allies’ wrath on a chosen foe.

name: Edict of Unyielding Resolve
target: Self and each ally in the area
effect: Until the end of the encounter or until you are dying, each target who starts their turn in the area gains 10 temporary Stamina.
description: You and your allies are clad in shimmering armor.

name: Intercede
type: Triggered Action (A creature makes a strike against the target.)
effect: The target is unaffected by the strike and you become the target instead, even if you aren’t a valid target for it. You take half the damage from the strike, and the target gains 3 surges.
description: You take your ally’s place.

name: Sentenced
effect: While the target is restrained this way, your abilities that impose forced movement can still move them.
description: The shock of your condemnation freezes your enemy in their boots.

name: Fade
tier_1: 2 + M or A damage; you shift 1 square
tier_2: 5 + M or A damage; you shift up to 2 squares
tier_3: 7 + M or A damage; you shift up to 3 squares
description: A stab, and a few quick, careful steps back.

name: Arise!
effect: The target can spend any number of Recoveries, can end any effects on them that are ended by a saving throw or that end at the end of their turn, and can stand up if they are prone. Additionally, at the start of each of their turns until the end of the encounter or until they are dying, the target gains 3 surges.
description: Your deity rewards you or an ally on the verge of defeat with a miracle burst of strength and resolve.

name: Beacon of Grace
effect: Until the end of the encounter, whenever you or any ally damages the target using an ability, that creature can spend a Recovery. If the target is reduced to 0 Stamina before the end of the encounter, you can use a free triggered action to move this effect to another creature within distance.
description: You ignite a foe with holy radiance, rewarding allies who attack them.

name: Blessed Light
effect: One ally within distance gains a number of surges equal to the tier outcome of your power roll.
description: Burning radiance falls upon your foe, transferring some of their energy to a nearby ally.

name: Blessing of Steel
target: Self and each ally in the area
effect: Until the end of the encounter, any ability roll made against a target takes a bane and each target has damage immunity 5.
description: A protective aura defends your allies from harm.

name: Blessing of the Blade
target: Self and each ally in the area
effect: At the end of each of your turns until the end of the encounter or until you are dying, each target gains 3 surges.
description: “The power of the gods is within you, friends. Allow me to unleash it.”

name: Call the Thunder Down
effect: You can push each willing ally in the area the same distance, ignoring stability.
description: You ask your saint for thunder and your prayer is answered.

name: Corruption's Curse
tier_1: 3 + I corruption damage; M < [weak], damage weakness 5 (save ends)
tier_2: 6 + I corruption damage; M < [average], damage weakness 5 (save ends)
tier_3: 9 + I corruption damage; M < [strong], damage weakness 5 (save ends)
description: Cursed by you, your enemy takes more damage from your allies.

name: Curse of Terror
tier_1: 6 + I holy damage; I < [weak], frightened (save ends)
tier_2: 9 + I holy damage; I < [average], frightened (save ends)
tier_3: 13 + I holy damage; I < [strong], frightened (save ends)
description: Fear of divine judgment overwhelms your foe.

name: Drag the Unworthy
effect: Each ally the target comes adjacent to during the forced movement can spend a Recovery.
description: You conjure an angel who moves a foe and heals your allies.

name: Drain
effect: You or one ally within distance can spend a Recovery.
description: You drain the energy from your target and revitalize yourself or an ally.

name: Faith is Our Armor
effect: You can target yourself instead of one ally with this ability.
description: The heroes’ armor glows with golden light, granting divine protection.

name: Fear of the Gods
effect: Each target is frightened of you or a creature you choose within distance.
description: Your divine magic makes a creature appear as what your enemies fear most.

name: Font of Wrath
effect: You summon a spirit of size 2 who can’t be harmed, and who appears in an unoccupied space within distance. The spirit lasts until the end of your next turn. You and your allies can move through the spirit’s space, but enemies can’t. Any enemy who moves within 2 squares of the spirit for the first time in a combat round or starts their turn there takes holy damage equal to your Intuition score.
description: A brilliant column of holy light appears on the battlefield, striking out at nearby enemies.

name: Healing Grace
effect:
The target can spend a Recovery.

Spend 1: For each piety spent, you can choose one of the following enhancements:

* You can target one additional ally within distance.
* You can end one effect on a target that is ended by a saving throw or that ends at the end of their turn.
* A prone target can stand up.
* A target can spend 1 additional Recovery.
description: Your divine energy restores the righteous.

name: Holy Lash
description: A tendril of divine energy shoots forth to draw in your foe.

name: Judgment's Hammer
tier_3: 9 + I holy damage; A < [strong], prone and can’t stand (save ends)
description: Your divine fury is a hammer that crashes down upon the unrighteous.

name: Lightfall
effect: You can teleport yourself and each ally in the area to unoccupied spaces in the area.
description: A rain of holy light scours your enemies and repositions your allies.

name: Penance
tier_1: 4 corruption damage; I < [weak], prone and can’t stand (save ends)
tier_2: 7 corruption damage; I < [average], prone and can’t stand (save ends)
tier_3: 11 corruption damage; I < [strong], prone and can’t stand (save ends)
description: “If you won’t kneel, the gods will make you.”

name: Ray of Wrath
effect: You can have this ability deal holy damage.
description: You unleash a blast of holy light upon your foe.

name: Sacrificial Offer
effect: Choose yourself or one ally within distance. That character can impose a bane on one power roll made against them before the end of their next turn.
description: Divine magic tears at your foe and defends a nearby friend.

name: Saint's Raiment
effect: The target gains 20 temporary Stamina and 3 surges.
description: An ally becomes the wearer of an empowered golden cloak.

name: Sanctuary
effect: The target is removed from the encounter map until the start of their next turn and can spend any number of Recoveries. At the start of their turn, the target reappears in the space they left or the nearest unoccupied space of their choice.
description: You send yourself or an ally to a divine manifold to instantaneously regain health.

name: Sermon of Grace
effect: Each target can spend a Recovery. Additionally, each target can use a free triggered action to end one effect on them that is ended by a saving throw or that ends at the end of their turn, or to stand up if prone.
description: You inspire your allies with tales of your saint’s great deeds.

name: Soul Siphon
effect: One ally within distance can spend any number of Recoveries.
description: A beam of energy connects a foe to a friend, draining life from one to heal the other.

name: Staggering Curse
description: A blast of judgment disorients your foe.

name: Vessel of Retribution
effect: The first time the target is dying or winded before the end of the encounter, each enemy within 5 squares of them takes 15 holy damage.
description: You infuse yourself or an ally with the retributive energy of the gods, waiting to be unleashed.

name: Violence Will Not Aid Thee
effect: The first time on a turn that the target deals damage to another creature, the target of this ability takes 1d10 lightning damage (save ends).
description: After some holy lightning, your enemy will think twice about their next attack.

name: Warrior's Prayer
effect: You or one ally within distance gains temporary Stamina equal to your Intuition score.
description: Your quickly uttered prayer lends aggressive divine energy to a friend engaged in melee.

name: Wither
tier_1: 3 + I corruption damage; P < [weak], the target takes a bane on their next power roll
tier_2: 5 + I corruption damage; P < [average], the target takes a bane on their next power roll
tier_3: 8 + I corruption damage; P < [strong], the target takes a bane on their next power roll
description: A bolt of holy energy saps the life from a foe.

name: Word of Guidance
type: Triggered Action (The target makes an ability roll for a damage-dealing ability.)
effect:
The power roll gains an edge.

Spend 1: The power roll has a double edge.
description: You invigorate an attacking ally with divine energy.

name: Word of Judgment
type: Triggered Action (The target would take damage from an ability that uses a power roll.)
effect:
The power roll takes a bane against the target.

Spend 1: The power roll has a double bane against the target.
description: Your holy word saps an attacking enemy’s strength.

name: Words of Wrath and Grace
effect: Each ally in the area can spend a Recovery.
description: Your saint grants your enemies a vision of pain and fills your allies with healing energy.

name: Corrupted Spirit
effect: Until the end of your turn, whenever you use a damage-dealing heroic ability against a single target, you can weaken that target’s life force. The ability deals extra corruption damage equal to your highest characteristic score.
description: You unlock the sinister secrets of pain

name: Wing Buffet
effect: You can shift up to 2 squares before or after making the power roll.
description: Foes who try to close in around you do so at their peril.

name: Divine Dragon
effect:
You conjure a size 4 dragon that appears in an unoccupied space within distance. The dragon has speed 6 and can fly, stability 4, 100 Stamina, immunity all to fire damage, and uses your characteristics. The dragon disappears at the end of the encounter, if their Stamina drops to 0, or if you are dying.

On subsequent turns, you can use a main action to command the dragon to breathe magic fire in a 3 cube within 1 square of them. Make the following power roll targeting each enemy in the area.

Additionally, you can use a maneuver to move the dragon up to their speed, or to make a melee weapon strike with their claw against an adjacent creature or object. The dragon can also make this strike as a free strike.
description: From nothing but divine will, you create a powerful ally.

name: Gods’ Machine
effect:
You conjure a size 2 rolling machine that appears in an unoccupied space within distance. The machine has 50 Stamina and immunity all to poison and psychic damage. It disappears at the end of the encounter, if its Stamina drops to 0, or if you are dying. When the machine first appears, make the following power roll once, targeting each enemy adjacent to it.

Once on each subsequent turn, you can use a free maneuver to move the machine a number of squares up to your Intuition score then repeat the power roll.
description: You conjure a whirring tank made of blades and metal.

name: Hands Of The Maker
effect: You create a mundane object of size 1S or smaller. You can maintain a number of objects created this way equal to your Intuition score. You can destroy an object created this way with a thought, no matter how far you are from it (no action required).
description: You can craft objects with the power of your mind.

name: Statue of Power
effect: A size 2 statue rises out of the ground in an unoccupied space within distance and lasts until the end of the encounter. While within 3 squares of the statue, you gain 1 surge at the start of each of your turns. Each ally within 3 squares of the statue gains this same benefit. The statue is destroyed if it takes 20 or more damage. It has immunity all to poison and psychic damage.
description: A marble statue of your deity rises from the earth.

name: Aura of Souls
effect: Until the end of the encounter or until you are dying, at the end of each of your turns, you can slide each creature in the area up to a number of squares equal to your Intuition score. This forced movement ignores stability for your allies.
description: A whirlwind of souls of the dead flies around you at your command.

name: Grave Speech
effect: You can speak to the target if they are a creature who has died within the last 24 hours and who can speak a language you know, even if they are just a head. The target regards you as they would have in life, and you might need to make tests to influence them and convince them to speak with you. The trauma of dying can make a creature’s memory of that event hazy, but the target otherwise knows all they knew in life. After 1 minute, the effect ends. You can’t use this ability on the same creature twice.
description: You commune with the lingering soul of the recently dead.

name: Reap
effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time a target kills an enemy, they regain Stamina equal to 5 + your Intuition score.
description: The gods reward those who smite their foes.

name: Word of Final Redemption
effect: Before the target dies, you can look at their stat block and force them to use one ability that is a main action or a maneuver. If the ability costs a Heroic Resource or Malice, the creature can use it without any cost. For the purpose of using this ability, your allies and enemies are the target’s allies and enemies, and you decide who the ability targets.
description: Your death will fuel our victory.

name: Glowing Eyes
type: Triggered Action (You take damage from a creature)
effect: Whenever you take damage from a creature, you can use a triggered action to deal that creature psychic damage equal to 1d10 + your level.
description: Your eyes are a solid, vibrant color that flares to show your excitement or rage.

name: Draconian Guard
type: Triggered Action (You, or a creature adjacent to you, takes damage from a strike)
effect: You reduce the damage from the strike by an amount equal to your level.
description: You can swing your wings around and guard against a blow.

name: Draconic Pride
description: You let loose a mighty roar to shake your foes’ spirits.

name: Dragon Breath
effect: You choose the ability’s damage type from acid, cold, corruption, fire, lightning, or poison.
description: A furious exhalation of energy washes over your foes.

name: Remember your Oath
effect:
As a maneuver, you can recite the following oath.

> Even should the sun stop in the sky
> Even should the night last a thousand years
> I will stand forever
> I shall not yield
> Those who suffer and yearn for justice
> I am your sword and shield
> I will yield no ground
> I will speak no lies
> I will stand against all tyrants
> Until the last villain dies.
 
Until the start of your next turn, whenever you make a saving throw, you succeed on a 4 or higher.

name: Double Strike
effect: If you use this ability on your turn, you can use it against one target, then use your maneuver and your move action for that turn before using the ability against a second target. You still use the same power roll for both targets.
description: Why strike once when you could do it twice?

name: Stonemeld
effect: You gain concealment. This concealment lasts until you leave the square or use an ability.

name: A Meteoric Introduction
description: You give your enemy a gentle tap - like an asteroid impact.

name: Afflict a Bountiful Decay
effect: Choose yourself or one ally within distance. That character can end one effect on them that is ended by a saving throw or that ends at the end of their turn.
description: Your curse causes a foe’s flesh to rot off as spores that aid your allies.

name: Behold the Mystery
effect: Persist 1: At the start of your turn, you can use a maneuver to use this ability again without spending essence.
description: You open a rift into the void to harry your foes.

name: Bifurcated Incineration
description: Two jets of flame lance out at your command.

name: Conflagration
effect: Persist 2: At the start of your turn, you can use a maneuver to use this ability again without spending essence.
description: A storm of fire descends upon your enemies.

name: Grasp of Beyond
effect: You can teleport up to a number of squares equal to your Reason score.
description: You absorb the life energy of another creature and use it to teleport.

name: Hurl Element
effect: When you make this strike, choose the damage type from one of the following options: acid, cold, corruption, fire, lightning, poison, or sonic.
description: You hurl a ball of elemental energy at an unsuspecting foe.

name: Instantaneous Excavation
tier_1: The target can shift 1 square from the edge of the hole to the nearest unoccupied space of their choice.
tier_2: The target falls into the hole.
tier_3: The target falls into the hole and can’t reduce the height of the fall.
effect:
You open up two holes with 1-square openings that are 4 squares deep, which can be placed on any mundane surface within distance. You can place these holes next to each other to create fewer holes with wider openings. When the holes open, make a separate power roll for each creature on the ground above a hole and small enough to fall in. (You can’t score a critical hit with this ability because it uses a maneuver.)

Persist 1: At the start of your turn, you open another hole, making a power roll against each creature who could fall into the hole when it opens without spending essence.
description: The surface of the world around you opens up at your command.

name: Invigorating Growth
effect: Mushrooms cover the target’s body. While the mushrooms are on the target, you and any ally adjacent to the target gain 1 surge whenever the target takes damage. The mushrooms can be removed by the target or an adjacent creature as a main action.
description: Mushrooms erupt from a foe, sapping their vitality to spread strengthening spores.

name: No More than a Breeze
effect:
Until the start of your next turn, the target can move through solid matter, they ignore difficult terrain, and their movement can’t provoke opportunity attacks. If the target ends their turn inside solid matter, they are forced out into the space where they entered it and this effect ends.

Persist 1: The effect lasts until the start of your next turn.
description: The material substance of a creature shreds away at your command.

name: Practical Magic
effect:
Choose one of the following effects:

* You use the Knockback maneuver, but its distance becomes the range of your Hurl Element ability, and you use Reason instead of Might for the power roll.
* You choose a creature within the distance of your Hurl Element ability and one of the following damage types: acid, cold, corruption, fire, lightning, poison, or sonic. That creature takes damage of the chosen type equal to your Reason score.
* You teleport up to a number of squares equal to your Reason score. If you choose this option, you can spend essence to teleport 1 additional square for each essence spent.
description: Your mastery of elemental power lets you customize your conjurations.

name: Ray of Agonizing Self Reflection
tier_1: 2 + R corruption damage; R < [weak], slowed (save ends)
tier_2: 4 + R corruption damage; R < [average], slowed (save ends)
tier_3: 6 + R corruption damage; R < [strong], slowed (save ends)
description: You inflict pain and doubt in equal measure.

name: Ripples in the Earth
effect: You must be touching the ground to use this ability. Additionally, you can choose a square of ground in the area that is unoccupied or is occupied by you or any ally. A pillar of earth rises out of the ground in that square, with a height in squares up to your Reason score. The pillar can’t collide with any creatures or objects, nor can it force creatures raised by it to collide with other creatures or objects.
description: Like a stone dropped into a pond, waves in the earth radiate from you.

name: Test of Rain
effect: You can end one effect on yourself that is ended by a saving throw or that ends at the end of your turn. Each ally in the area also gains this benefit.
description: You call down a rain that burns your enemies and restores your allies.

name: The Flesh, a Crucible
effect: Persist 1: If the target is within distance at the start of your turn, make a power roll for this ability again.
description: Fire engulfs your target and continues to churn.

name: The Green Within, The Green Without
effect: You slide one creature within 10 squares of the target up to 2 squares.
description: Whipping vines erupt from a foe’s body to grasp at another close by.

name: Unquiet Ground
effect: The ground beneath the area becomes difficult terrain for enemies.
description: A sudden storm of detritus assaults your foes and leaves them struggling to move.

name: Viscous Fire
description: A jet of heavy fire erupts where you strike.

name: Ward of Nature's Affection
type: Triggered Action (A creature within a number of squares equal to your Reason score deals damage to you,)
effect: You slide the attacking creature up to a number of squares equal to your Reason score.
description: You store green energy within your body that allows you to produce powerful vines when you’re in danger.

name: Ward of Surprising Reactivity
type: Triggered Action (An adjacent creature deals damage to you.)
effect: You push that creature a number of squares equal to twice your Reason score.
description: You use the magic of fire to create a ward of explosive energy.

name: O Flower Aid, O Earth Defend
effect:
Until the start of your next turn, the area gains the following effects:

* Once as a free maneuver at the start of your turn, you allow yourself and each ally in the area to spend any number of Recoveries.
* The area is difficult terrain for enemies.
* Each enemy who enters the area for the first time in a combat round or starts their turn there takes damage equal to your Reason score.

Persist 1: The area remains until the start of your next turn. As a maneuver, you can move the area up to 5 squares. This ability ends if the area is ever not within your line of effect.
description: Revitalizing plants and jagged stones grow, helping allies and hindering foes.

name: Subvert the Green Within
effect: The target uses their signature ability against a creature of your choice. This signature ability can target the creature even if it usually wouldn’t. You then make a power roll against the target of this ability.
description: Fungal spores sprout inside your enemy’s brain, allowing you to control their actions.

name: Translated Through Flame
effect: The target is teleported to another space within distance. Make a power roll that affects each enemy adjacent to the target’s new space.
description: Your ally disappears, then reappears in a burst of fire!

name: Volcano's Embrace
tier_1: 5 + R fire damage; A < [weak], restrained (save ends)
tier_2: 9 + R fire damage; A < [average], restrained (save ends)
tier_3: 12 + R fire damage; A < [strong], restrained (save ends)
description: Wrap them up in fire and melting stone.

name: Erase
effect:
The number of creatures you target with this ability is determined by your power roll.

Each target begins to fade from existence (save ends). On their first turn while fading from existence, a target takes a bane on power rolls. At the end of their first turn, they have a double bane on power rolls. At the end of their second turn, they fade from existence for 1 hour, after which they reappear in their original space or the nearest unoccupied space.
description: With a flick of the wrist, you phase creatures out of existence.

name: Maw of Earth
effect: The ground in or directly beneath the area drops 3 squares.
description: You open up the ground, unleashing a shower of stone and debris.

name: Swarm of Spirits
effect:
Until the end of your next turn, each ally in the area has each of their characteristic scores treated as 1 higher for the purpose of resisting potencies, and has a +1 bonus to saving throws.

Persist 1: You make the power roll again to target each enemy in the area without spending essence, and the effect lasts until the start of your next turn.
description: Guardian animal spirits surround you to harry your foes and bolster your allies.

name: Wall of Fire
effect:
The wall lasts until the start of your next turn, and can be placed in occupied squares. Creatures can enter and pass through the wall. Each enemy who enters the area for the first time in a combat round or starts their turn there takes fire damage equal to your Reason score for each square of the area they start their turn in or enter.

Persist 1: The wall lasts until the start of your next turn, and you can add a number of squares to the wall equal to your Reason score.
description: A blazing, beautifully organized inferno erupts at your command.

name: Combustion Deferred
effect: When the target ends their next turn, or if they drop to 0 Stamina before then, each enemy adjacent to them takes fire damage equal to twice your Reason score. Each affected enemy then gains this same effect.
description: Your flames dance from kindling to kindling to kindling.

name: Storm of Sands
effect:
The area lasts until the start of your next turn. It is difficult terrain for enemies, and you and your allies have concealment while in the area.

Persist 1: The area remains until the start of your next turn, and you can move it up to 5 squares (no action required). As a maneuver, you can make the power roll again without spending essence.
description: Dirt and debris swirl into a dark, pulsing hurricane.

name: Subverted Perception of Space
tier_2: 10 + R corruption damage; the target has line of effect only to creatures and objects within 4 squares of them until the start of your next turn
tier_3: 15 + R corruption damage; the target has line of effect only to adjacent creatures and objects until the start of your next turn
effect: Persist 1: The target’s limited line of effect lasts until the start of your next turn.
description: You rip an enemy’s world in twain.

name: Web of All That's Come Before
effect:
The area is difficult terrain until the start of your next turn. Each enemy who ends their turn in the area is restrained (save ends).

Persist 1: The area remains until the start of your next turn.
description: Threads you’ve been weaving through your adventures create a vibrant, pearlescent web.

name: Luminous Champion Aloft
effect:
The target has a +3 bonus to speed, they can fly, and their abilities ignore concealment. Additionally, whenever the target gains their Heroic Resource, they gain 1 additional Heroic Resource. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

Persist 1: The effect lasts until the start of your next turn.
description: They shine vibrantly, a beautiful diamond in the night sky.

name: Magma Titan
effect:
Until the start of your next turn, the target has the following benefits:

* Their size and stability increase by 2, with any size 1 target becoming size 3. Each creature who is within the target’s new space slides to the nearest unoccupied space, ignoring stability. If the target doesn’t have space to grow, they grow as much as they can and become restrained until the effect ends.
* They have fire immunity 10.
* Their strikes deal extra fire damage equal to twice your Reason score.
* When the target force moves a creature or object, the forced movement distance gains a +2 bonus.
* They can use their highest characteristic instead of Might for Might power rolls.

Persist 2: The effect lasts until the start of your next turn. Additionally, at the start of your turn, the target can spend 2 Recoveries.
description: Their body swells with lava, mud, and might, towering over their enemies.

name: Meteor
tier_1: You teleport the target up to 4 squares.
tier_2: You teleport the target up to 6 squares.
tier_3: You teleport the target up to 8 squares.
effect: If the target is teleported to a space where they would fall, they immediately do so, treating the fall as if their Agility score were 0. The target takes fire damage from the fall, and each enemy within 3 squares of where they land takes the same amount of fire damage. The ground within 3 squares of where the target lands is difficult terrain.
description: You teleport the target into the air and let the ground and the elemental force of fire do the rest.

name: The Wode Remembers and Returns
effect:
The area becomes dark and verdant, with trees and plant life appearing in unoccupied spaces within it until the start of your next turn. The area is difficult terrain for enemies, and any ally who ends their turn in the area has cover.

Persist 2: The area remains until the start of your next turn. Additionally, at the start of your turn, each ally in the area can spend a Recovery.
description: You create a terrarium that spans from canopy above to underbrush below.

name: Heart of the Wode
effect:
A size 5 tree appears in an unoccupied space within distance. The tree has 100 Stamina and can’t be force moved. You and any ally can touch the tree to use the Catch Breath maneuver as a free maneuver. Additionally, when you start your turn with line of effect to the tree, you can end one effect on yourself that is ended by a saving throw or that ends at the end of your turn, or you can stand up if you are prone. Each ally within distance also gains this benefit.

Each enemy who ends their turn within 3 squares of the tree is restrained until the end of their next turn. A creature restrained this way can use a main action to end the effect early.
description: You call forth one of the Great Tree’s many splinters to provide for your every need.

name: Muse of Fire
tier_1: 7 fire damage; the Director loses 2 Malice
tier_2: 10 fire damage; the Director loses 3 Malice
tier_3: 15 fire damage; the Director loses 4 Malice
effect: The Director’s Malice can become negative as a result of this ability.
description: The fire burns hot enough to sear the face of any god watching.

name: Return to Oblivion
effect: You create a size 1L vortex that lasts until the end of the encounter. At the start of each combat round while the vortex is unoccupied, the vortex vertical pulls 3 each enemy within 5 squares of it. Each enemy who enters the vortex or starts their turn there is knocked prone. At the end of the round, if a winded enemy who is not a leader or solo creature is in the vortex, they are instantly destroyed.
description: You create a tear in reality that could consume everything.

name: World Torn Asunder
effect: You create a fissure in the ground adjacent to you that is a 10 × 2 line and 6 squares deep. Each creature in the area who is prone and size 2 or smaller falls in. Other creatures can enter the fissure or can shift to the nearest unoccupied space of their choice outside it.
description: You stomp your foot and quake the whole world over.

name: Earth Rejects You
target: Each enemy and object in the area
effect: Persist 2: At the start of your turn, you can use a maneuver to use this ability again without spending essence.
description: Everyone and everything gets blown away in an eruption of rocks and debris.

name: Prism
effect: You use up to three heroic abilities whose essence costs total 11 or less, spending no additional essence beyond the cost of this ability. You can shift up to 2 squares between your use of each ability.
description: You split your essence, allowing you to cast multiple effects at once.

name: The Green Defends Its Servants
effect:
You conjure an elemental shield that protects the target until the end of your next turn. While the shield is active, the target can take the Defend main action as a maneuver on each of their turns. The target gains 30 temporary Stamina that lasts until depleted or until the effect ends. If this temporary Stamina disappears, the effect ends and the shield explodes, dealing 10 damage to each enemy within 5 squares of the target

Persist 2: The effect lasts until the start of your next turn.
description: A luminous green shield shows its true beauty the more it cracks.

name: Unquenchable Fire
tier_1: 13 + R fire damage; I < [weak] , dazed (save ends)
tier_2: 18 + R fire damage; I < [average] , dazed (save ends)
tier_3: 25 + R fire damage; I < [strong] , dazed (save ends)
effect: This damage ignores immunity.
description: You let fly a fiery missile braided with pure primal energy.

name: Motivate Earth
effect:
You touch a square containing mundane dirt, stone, or metal and create a 5 wall of the same material, which rises up out of the ground and must include the square you touched.

Alternatively, you touch a structure made of mundane dirt, stone, or metal that occupies 2 or more squares. You can open a 1-square opening in the structure where you touched it. You can instead touch an existing doorway or other opening that is 1 square or smaller in a mundane dirt, stone, or metal surface. The opening is sealed by the same material that makes up the surface.
description: The earth rises, falls, or opens up at your command.

name: Skin Like Castle Walls
effect:
The damage is halved.

Spend 1: If the damage has any potency effect associate with it, the potency is reduced by 1.
description: You cover yourself or an ally in protective stone.

name: Summon Source of Earth
effect:
A source of earth emerges from an unoccupied space within distance. The source takes their turn immediately after you, moving up to their speed and either taking a main action or a maneuver. The source is dismissed at the start of your next turn.

The source starts an encounter at full Stamina, but maintains their current Stamina throughout the encounter, even if they are dismissed and you use this ability again. They can’t regain Stamina during the encounter. When the source’s Stamina is reduced to 0, you can’t use this ability again until you earn 1 or more Victories.

Persist 2: The source takes another turn. They are dismissed at the start of your next turn.
description: The ground rumbles as an elemental bursts forth, ready to serve.

name: The Earth Accepts Me
effect: You step into a mundane dirt, metal, or stone object (including a wall) that is as large as you or larger. You can remain inside the object for as long as you like. While inside the object, you can observe events and speak to creatures outside it, but you don’t have line of effect to anything outside the object and vice versa. You can travel through the object freely until you exit it. If the object you meld with is destroyed, you take 10 damage and exit the object.
description: You can slip into the stone.

name: The Mountain Does Not Move
type: Triggered Action (The target is force moved)
distance: The distance of your Hurl Element ability
effect: You decrease your stability down to a minimum of 0, then increase the target’s stability by an amount equal to the stability you lost. This change lasts until the end of the round.

name: Explosive Assistance
type: Triggered Action (The target force moves a creature or object.)
effect:
The forced movement distance gains a bonus equal to your Reason score.

Spend 1: The forced movement distance gains a bonus equal to twice your Reason score instead.
description: You add a little magic to an ally’s aggression at just the right time.

name: Return to Formlessness
effect: You heat the target and cause it to melt or combust, destroying it. If the object is larger than 1 square, then only the square of the object you touch is destroyed.
description: With the merest touch, you cause an object to turn into slag or ash.

name: Breath of Dawn Remembered
type: Triggered Action (The target starts their turn or takes damage.)
effect:
The target can spend a Recovery.

Spend 1: The target can spend an additional Recovery for each essence spent.
description: The power you channel grants the ability to get back in the fight.

name: Remember Growth and Sun and Rain
effect: You see and hear any events that have occurred within 10 squares of the object within the last 12 hours, perceiving those events from the object’s location as if you were there.
description: You stir any wood’s memory and learn what it has seen.

name: Shared Void Sense
effect: For each Victory you have, you can target one creature. Each target gains the benefit of your A Beyonding of Vision feature until the end of your next turn, but doesn’t gain the use of the Shared Void Sense ability.
description: You grant allies a taste of your unearthly vision.

name: Subtle Relocation
type: Triggered Action (The target starts their turn, moves, or is force moved.)
effect:
You teleport the target up to a number of squares equal to your Reason score. If the target moves to trigger this ability, you can teleport them at any point during the move.

Spend 1: You teleport the target up to a number of squares equal to twice your Reason score instead.
description: You call on the void to swallow and spit out an ally.

name: There is No Space Between
effect:
You open two size 1 portals in unoccupied spaces within distance, which last until you move beyond distance from any portal, end the effect as a maneuver, or are dying. Each portal must be placed at a height of no more than 1 square above the ground. When you or any ally touch a portal, that creature can choose to be instantly teleported to an unoccupied space of their choice adjacent to the other portal. If an enemy is force moved into a portal, their forced movement ends and they emerge from the other portal in an unoccupied space chosen by the creature who force moved them.

At the start of each of your turns while the portals are active, you can open a new portal connected to the others. If three or more portals are present, you and your allies choose which portal to emerge from when entering a portal, and a creature who force moves an enemy into a portal chooses that enemy’s destination portal.
description: Knowledge of the mystery reveals that two spaces are the same space.

name: Glamor of Terror
type: Triggered Action (You take damage from a creature)
effect: Whenever you take damage from a creature, you can use a triggered action to make that creature frightened of you until the end of their next turn.
description: When a foe strikes, you reverse the magic of your glamor to instill fear into their heart.

name: The Wode Defends
tier_1: 2 + M or A damage; A < [weak] slowed (save ends)
tier_2: 3 + M or A damage; A < [average] slowed (save ends)
tier_3: 5 + M or A damage; A < [strong] restrained (save ends)
description: Thorny vines erupt into existence and attempt to bind your foe.

name: Bend Fate
effect: Until the end of the encounter or until you are dying, each of the target’s power rolls has its outcome improved by one tier.
description: The gods know you must prevail, and they bless your fate.

name: Blessing of Fate and Destiny
effect:
You can target yourself instead of one creature with this ability. Choose one of the following effects, which lasts until the end of the encounter or until you are dying:

* Whenever a target makes a power roll, they can roll three dice and choose which two rolls to use.
* Whenever a target makes a power roll, they must roll three dice and use the lowest two rolls.
description: Your enemies suffer their fate; your allies embrace their destiny!

name: Your Story Ends Here
tier_1: 9 + I corruption damage; R < [weak], weakened (save ends)
tier_2: 14 + I corruption damage; R < [average], weakened (save ends)
tier_3: 19 + I corruption damage; R < [strong], weakened (save ends)
effect: If this damage kills the target, you and each ally within distance can spend a Recovery.
description: You bend the fate of a foe, willing them to die.

name: Back!
description: You hew about you with your mighty weapon, hurling enemies backward.

name: Blood for Blood!
tier_1: 4 + M damage; M < [weak], bleeding and weakened (save ends)
tier_2: 6 + M damage; M < [average], bleeding and weakened (save ends)
tier_3: 10 + M damage; M < [strong], bleeding and weakened (save ends)
effect: You can deal 1d6 damage to yourself to deal an extra 1d6 damage to the target.
description: See how well they fight after you’ve bled them dry.

name: Brutal Slam
description: The heavy impact of your weapon attacks drives your foes ever back.

name: Debilitating Strike
effect: While slowed this way, the target takes 1 damage for every square they move, including from forced movement.
description: You need just one blow to sabotage your target.

name: Demon Unleashed
effect: Until the end of the encounter or until you are dying, each enemy who starts their turn adjacent to you and has P < [strong] is frightened until the end of their turn.
description: Foes tremble at the sight of you.

name: Elemental Ferocity
effect: You gain 10 temporary Stamina. Additionally, choose acid, cold, corruption, fire, lightning, poison, or sonic damage. Until the end of the encounter or until you are dying, whenever an enemy damages you, they take 10 damage of the chosen type. If this damage reduces the enemy to 0 Stamina, you gain 10 temporary Stamina.
description: Your primordial energy makes for instant retribution.

name: Face the Storm!
effect: Until the end of the encounter or until you are dying, each creature you make a melee strike against who has P < [average] is taunted until the end of their next turn. Additionally, when you use an ability that deals rolled damage against any enemy taunted by you, the ability deals extra damage equal to twice your Might score and increases its potency by 1.
description: Shocked in the face of your naked brutality, your enemy’s instincts take over.

name: Hit And Run
effect: You can shift 1 square.
description: Staying in constant motion helps you slip out of reach after a brutal assault.

name: Impaled!
target: One creature of your size or smaller
description: You skewer your enemy like a boar upon a spit.

name: Make Peace With Your God!
effect: You gain 1 surge, and the next ability roll you make this turn automatically obtains a tier 3 outcome.
description: Anger is an energy.

name: My Turn!
type: Triggered Action (A creature causes you to be winded or dying, or damages you while you are winded or dying.)
effect: You can spend a Recovery.
description: You quickly strike back at a foe.

name: Out of the Way!
effect: When you slide the target, you can move into any square they leave. If you take damage from an opportunity attack by moving this way, the target takes the same damage.
description: Your enemies will clear your path — whether they want to or not.

name: Overkill
effect: If the target is a minion or is winded but isn’t a leader or solo creature, they are reduced to 0 Stamina before this ability’s damage is dealt. If the target is killed by this damage, you can deal any damage over what was required to kill them to another creature within 5 squares of the target.
description: You strike so no damage is wasted.

name: Primordial Rage
effect: Choose acid, cold, corruption, fire, lightning, poison, or sonic damage. Until the end of the encounter or until you are dying, you can choose one target of any ability you use, with that target taking an extra 15 damage of the chosen type. Additionally, whenever you gain ferocity from taking damage, the source of the damage takes 5 damage of the chosen type.
description: Your ferocity manifests into primordial power.

name: Rebounding Storm
effect: When a target would end this forced movement by colliding with a creature or object, they take damage as usual, then are pushed the remaining distance away from the creature or object in the direction they came from. As long as forced movement remains, this effect continues if the target collides with another creature or object.
description: You knock around enemies like playthings.

name: Relentless Death
tier_1: Any target whose Stamina is equal to or less than 8 dies.
tier_2: Any target whose Stamina is equal to or less than 11 dies.
tier_3: Any target whose Stamina is equal to or less than 17 dies.
effect: You shift up to your speed. Each enemy you move adjacent to during this movement takes damage equal to twice your Might score. Then make one power roll that targets each enemy you move adjacent to during this shift. You gain 1 ferocity for each target who dies as a result of this ability (maximum 11 ferocity).
description: You won’t escape your fate.

name: Steelbreaker
effect: You gain 20 temporary Stamina.
description: See how useless their weapons are!

name: Thunder Roar
effect: The targets are force moved one at a time, starting with the target nearest to you, and can be pushed into other targets in the same line.
description: You unleash a howl that hurls your enemies back.

name: Tide of Death
effect:
You move up to your speed in a straight line, and enemy squares are not difficult terrain for this movement. You can end this movement in a creature’s space and move them to an adjacent unoccupied space. You make one power roll that targets each enemy whose space you move through.

The last target you damage takes extra damage equal to your Might score for each opportunity attack you trigger during your move
description: Teach them the folly of lining up for you.

name: To Stone!
effect: While the target is slowed this way, any other effect that would make the target slowed instead makes them restrained by this ability. Additionally, a creature who fails the saving throw while restrained this way is petrified until they are given a supernatural cure or you choose to reverse the effect (no action required).
description: You channel the Primordial Chaos into blows that petrify your foe … literally.

name: To the Death!
effect: You gain 2 surges, and the target can make an opportunity attack against you as a free triggered action.
description: Your reckless assault leaves you tactically vulnerable.

name: To the Uttermost End
effect: Spend 1: While you are winded, this ability deals an extra 1d6 damage for each ferocity spent. While you are dying, it deals an extra 1d10 damage for each ferocity spent. In either case, you lose 1d6 Stamina after making this strike.
description: You gut your life force to ensure a foe’s demise.

name: You Are Already Dead
effect: If the target is not a leader or solo creature, they are reduced to 0 Stamina at the end of their next turn. If the target is a leader or solo creature, you gain 3 surges and can make a melee free strike against them.
description: Slash. Walk away.

name: Your Entrails Are Your Extrails!
effect: While bleeding this way, the target takes damage equal to your Might score at the end of your turns.
description: Hard for them to fight when they’re busy holding in their giblets.

name: Avalanche Impact
effect: You jump up to your maximum jump distance and make one power roll that targets each creature adjacent to the space where you land.
description: You leap and crash down, causing a shockwave that devastates foes.

name: Death Comes for You All!
effect: If this forced movement causes a target to be hurled through an object, that target takes an extra 10 damage.
description: You use your weapon to create a destructive shockwave.

name: Force of Storms
effect: When the target ends this forced movement, each creature within 2 squares of the target is pushed 3 squares.
description: You strike an enemy hard enough to be a projectile that knocks a crowd of creatures around.

name: Lines of Force
type: Triggered Action (The target would be force moved.)
effect:
You can select a new target of the same size or smaller within distance to be force moved instead. You become the source of the forced movement, determine the new target’s destination, and can push the target instead of using the original forced movement type. Additionally, the forced movement distance gains a bonus equal to your Might score.

Spend 1: The forced movement distance gains a bonus equal to twice your Might score instead.
description: You redirect the energy of motion.

name: Primordial Vortex
effect: If this forced movement causes a target to slam into you, you take no damage from the collision and the target takes the damage you would have taken.
description: You channel the power of the Primordial Chaos to pull foes to you.

name: Special Delivery
effect: You vertically push the target up to 4 squares. This forced movement ignores the target’s stability, and the target takes no damage from colliding with creatures or objects. At the end of this movement, the target can make a free strike that deals extra damage equal to your Might score.
description: You ready?

name: Wrecking Ball
effect:
You move up to your speed in a straight line. During this movement, you can move through mundane structures, including walls, which are difficult terrain for you. You automatically destroy each square of structure you move through and leave behind a square of difficult terrain.

Additionally, you make one power roll that targets each enemy you move adjacent to during this movement.
description: It’s easier to destroy than to create. Much easier, in fact!

name: Death ... Deeaaath!
tier_1: 3 + M damage; P < [weak], dazed and frightened (save ends)
tier_2: 5 + M damage; P < [average], dazed and frightened (save ends)
tier_3: 8 + M damage; P < [strong], dazed and frightened (save ends)
description: Your unbridled rage strikes terror in their hearts.

name: Death Strike
type: Triggered Action (You reduce a creature to 0 Stamina with a strike.)
effect: You target a creature adjacent to you with the same strike, using the same power roll as the triggering strike.
description: Once you taste your foe’s blood, you become more efficient and turn every killing blow into an opportunity.

name: Phalanx-Breaker
effect: You shift up to your speed and make one power roll that targets up to three enemies you move adjacent to during this shift.
description: Organizing your forces like feckless creatures of Law. Pitiful.

name: Primordial Bane
effect: Choose acid, cold, corruption, fire, lightning, poison, or sonic damage. The target loses any damage immunity to the chosen type and gains weakness 10 to the chosen type (save ends).
description: You attune the target to be weaker to a specific element.

name: Seek and Destroy
effect:
You shift up to your speed.

If a target who is not a leader or solo creature is winded by this strike, they are reduced to 0 Stamina and you choose an enemy within 5 squares of you. If that enemy has P < [average], they are frightened of you (save ends).
description: You break through the enemy lines to make an example.

name: Shower of Blood
effect: Each enemy within 5 squares of you is distracted until the end of the round. While a creature is distracted this way, they can’t take triggered actions or free triggered actions, ability rolls made against them gain an edge, and their characteristic scores are considered 1 lower for the purpose of resisting potencies.
description: You shock your foes with the brutality of your strike, resetting the balance of combat.

name: Unearthly Reflexes
effect:
You take half the damage from the triggering effect and can shift up to a number of squares equal to your Agility score.

Spend 1: If the damage has any potency effects associated with it, the potency is reduced by 1 for you.
description: You are as elusive as a hummingbird.

name: Apex Predator
effect: The target can’t be hidden from you for 24 hours. Until the end of the encounter, whenever the target willingly moves, you can use a free triggered action to move.
description: I will hunt you down.

name: Aspect of the Wild
effect:
You can shapeshift into the animal defined by your stormwight kit, into a hybrid form, or back into your true form. While in animal form or hybrid form, you can speak as you usually do, and you can also speak to animals who share your form. If you are in a negotiation with an animal while in animal form, you treat your Renown as 2 higher than usual.

Spend 1: As a free maneuver, you can shapeshift a second time, either into another animal form, into your hybrid form, or back into your true form.
description: You assume the form of the animal who channels your ferocity.

name: Death Rattle
tier_1: 4 psychic damage; any target who is a minion is reduced to 0 Stamina
tier_2: 6 psychic damage; any target who is a minion is reduced to 0 Stamina, as does one winded target who is not a leader or solo creature
tier_3: 10 psychic damage; each target who is not a leader or solo creature is winded; any target who is a minion is reduced to 0 Stamina, as does one winded target who is not a leader or solo creature
description: You unleash an otherworldly cry that rips through your enemies, killing the weakest of them.

name: Deluge
effect: This ability deals your primordial damage type and ignores damage immunity.
description: You summon your primordial storm.

name: Furious Change
type: Triggered Action (You lose Stamina and are not dying.)
effect:
You gain temporary Stamina equal to your Might score and can enter your animal form or hybrid form.

Spend 1: If you are not dying, you can spend a Recovery.
description: In your anger, you revert to a more bestial form.

name: Pounce
effect: You can shift up to 4 squares, bringing the target with you. While grabbed this way, the target takes damage equal to twice your Might score at the start of each of your turns.
description: You strike at the target like the ultimate predator you are.

name: Riders on the Storm
effect:
Until the end of the encounter or until you are dying, each enemy target takes damage of your primordial damage type equal to twice your Might score at the end of each of your turns. Additionally, you can fly while the aura is active. Each ally target who starts or ends their turn in the area can also fly until the start of their next turn or until the effect ends.

When you use this ability outside of combat without spending ferocity, you must spend 1 uninterrupted minute summoning a primordial storm that fills the area, and you take 1d6 damage before the ability takes effect. The storm lasts for 1 hour or until a combat encounter begins.
description: You focus your connection to the Primordial Chaos into a seething storm.

name: Visceral Roar
effect: This ability deals your primordial damage type.
description: The sound of the storm within you staggers your opponents.

name: The Harder They Fall
tier_1: 7 damage; M < [weak], prone and can't stand (save ends)
tier_2: 11 damage; M < [average], prone and can't stand (save ends)
tier_3: 16 damage; M < [strong], prone and can't stand (save ends)
effect: If the target is size 2 or larger, you gain an edge on this ability.
description: Timber!

name: Last-Ditch Prayer
effect: You recite a prayer for help, gaining a pool of 2d10 of the Heroic Resource granted by your class. This pool disappears at the end of your turn if you haven’t used it. Once you use this benefit, you can’t use it again until you perform another service for a god or saint, or until you gain a level.

name: Forward Thrust, Backward Smash
description: In your hands, the haft is as good as the head.

name: Timely Distraction
type: Triggered Action (An ally makes a test to lie to, pick the pocket of, hide from, or sneak by the target and doesn’t like the outcome.)
effect: You momentarily attract the target’s notice to let your ally reroll their test. Once you use this ability, you can’t use it again against the same target for 1 hour.
description:
Coming through with hot soup!

I better watch out for that banana peel!

name: Detect the Supernatural
effect: Until the end of your next turn, you know the location of any supernatural object, undead, construct, or creature from another world within 5 squares, even if you don’t have line of effect to that object or creature. You know if you’re detecting an item or a creature, and you know the nature of any creature you detect.
description: You open your awareness to detect supernatural creatures and phenomena.

name: Determination
effect: You immediately end one of the frightened, slowed, or weakened conditions on yourself.
description: A tolerance for pain and distress allows you to push through difficult situations.

name: Resist the Unnatural
type: Triggered Action (You take damage that isn’t untyped)
effect: You halve the damage.
description: Your instinctive resilience protects you from injuries beyond the routine.

name: Knightly Challenge
effect:
You can end the taunted condition on the target as a free maneuver.

If you take this title, you might occasionally be called upon to perform duties for the person who knighted you.
description: Have at thee!

name: Invocation of Undoing
effect: You can choose to have this ability deal damage to and push objects, and to deal damage to buildings.
description: You utter a secret word of destruction known only to deities.

name: The Gods Command, You Obey
tier_1: 4 + I holy damage; P < [weak], before taking damage, the target makes a free strike against a target you choose
tier_2: 7 + I holy damage; P < [average], before taking damage, the target uses an ability of your choice and you choose any targets for that ability
tier_3: 11 + I holy damage; P < [strong], before taking damage, the target shifts up to their speed to a location you choose, uses an ability of your choice, and you choose any targets for that ability
description: You speak with the voice of your saint, commanding your enemies.

name: Word of Weakening
tier_1: 10 + I corruption damage; A < [weak], weakened (save ends)
tier_2: 15 + I corruption damage; A < [average], weakened (save ends)
tier_3: 21 + I corruption damage; A < [strong], weakened (save ends)
effect: While weakened this way, the target has damage weakness 10.
description: You utter a divine word that makes a foe brittle.

name: Radiance of Grace
effect: You can target yourself instead of one ally with this ability. Each target can spend any number of Recoveries, can end any effects on them that are ended by a saving throw or that end at the end of their turn, and can stand up if they are prone.
description: Intense light is emitted from your body, healing your allies.

name: Revitalizing Grace
target: Self and each ally in the area
effect: Each target can spend any number of Recoveries. Additionally, each target can end one effect on themself that is ended by a saving throw or that ends at the end of their turn, or they can stand up if prone.
description: With a gesture, you restore your health and that of your allies.

name: Wellspring of Grace
effect: Until the end of the encounter or until you are dying, whenever a target starts their turn in the area, they can spend a Recovery.
description: A holy light is emitted from your body, healing your allies.

name: Share Head
effect: You can see, hear, and smell as if you were in the target’s space. Additionally, you can borrow their mouth to speak when you wish to do so, speaking in your own voice. This effect ends when you use Share Head on a different target, when the target moves more than 10 squares away from you, or when the creature is no longer willing to share their head with you.
description: You don’t have a head but can psionically borrow another.

name: Alacrity of the Heart
effect: The target has an additional main action they can use on their next turn, and gains 3 of their Heroic Resource.
description: You speak inspiring words to a friend and spur them to incredible feats.

name: Guided to Your Side
effect: Each target is teleported to unoccupied spaces within 5 squares of a willing creature who you are bonded to with your Invocation of the Heart feature. You don’t need line of effect to the bonded creature but you must be on the same world.
description: You concentrate on a friend and teleport to them.

name: Lauded by God
effect: Each target gains 3 of their Heroic Resource.
description: You beseech the gods to give your allies what they need to win the day, and the gods answer.

name: Our Hearts Your Strength
effect: Until the end of the encounter or until the target is dying, at the start of each of the target’s turns, they gain a bonus to speed and a bonus to rolled damage equal to the number of allies within 10 squares of them. This bonus lasts until the start of their next turn.
description: An ally gains strength from their friends.

name: The Devil’s Chord
tier_1: You take 4 sonic damage unless you have the Performance skill.
tier_3: 10 sonic damage; M < [average], weakened and bleeding (save ends)
effect: The soul of any creature killed by this ability is dragged to Hell.
description: Helloooo Orden!

name: Oh No You Don’t!
type: Triggered Action (Target uses an ability with the Magic keyword)
effect: Make a free strike.

name: Stink of Magic
effect: Until the end of your next turn, you are aware of whether each target is a construct, an undead, or a creature from another world, and whether they have used a magic ability in the previous hour.
description: You open your senses to the residue of magic

name: Heedless Pursuer
effect: You deal yourself 1d6 damage that can’t be reduced in any way. When you do, you ignore difficult terrain and you can increase the distance of any jump you make by 1 square, both until the end of your turn.
description: You open your senses to the residue of magic

name: Battle Grace
tier_2: 6 + M or A damage; you swap places with the target
tier_3: 9 + M or A damage; you swap places with the target
effect: If you obtain a tier 2 or tier 3 outcome and can't swap places with the target because one or both of you is too big to fit into the swapped space, you both remain in your original spaces and the target takes 1 extra damage.
description: You feint to move your enemies into perfect position.

name: Contact Spirits
tier_1: You take corruption damage equal to 5 + your level.
tier_2: The spirit of anyone you know of who has died speaks to you, provided they are on the same world as you. You learn how they died and can ask them one question, which they can answer truthfully or untruthfully. The spirit knows everything they knew in life, and is aware of events that took place in their immediate surroundings since their death
tier_3: As tier 2, but you can ask 3 questions.
